card.name: Repeated warning phrases on drug labels
card.fires_on: Words inside a few repeated warning phrases, such as 'sleep-walking' in complex sleep behaviors, 'reduce the strength, duration, and frequency of' uterine contractions, and 'carbamazepine'. It responds on the joining word or piece in the middle of the phrase.

modes.label: Inside drug names
modes.description: The middle piece of a drug name such as carbamazepine.

card.writes: It pushes toward 'activate/activation' words and away from 'exit' words, which has no obvious link to the label text.
card.plain: It fires on certain words in the middle of familiar warning sentences, like sleep-walking or labor-contraction wording.
